svg.title: Map of mango's parts
svg.desc: Four layers, from your code down to the wire. Your code: agents, composed of roles. Interaction: messaging and conversations, and topologies, a graph of neighbours that may span several containers. Time: every agent has a scheduler that runs on the clock of its runtime. Runtime and wire: containers, each with one codec that encodes outgoing and decodes incoming messages, which travel over TCP or MQTT; agents may also run in their own process. Instead of containers, a simulation world can deliver the messages with simulated delay and loss. Tracing runs alongside every layer: it records what happens in each, links event, message and task records to their causes, and shows them in a viewer. Each part links to its section below.

g.text: runs unchanged on a network or in simulation
